description: Searches concerts, sports, theatre, comedy and other live events in a city from a start date, from Ticketmaster and Bandsintown, with an optional end date, category (music, sports, arts, theater, family, comedy) and keyword such as an artist, team or show. Results include venue, date and time, price range and, where the source gives one, a link to the event page. Searching does not reserve anything or charge anyone.
name: search_events
